saccades.amplitude_deg.p50.note: VERIFIED x3: Mronz&Lehmann 2008 ~120deg/130ms (PMID 18552291); Tammero&Dickinson 2002 ~90deg/<100ms (PMID 11854370); Stupski&vanBreugel 2024 circling ~60deg (PMC11461137)

saccades.rate_hz.note: VERIFIED: Stupski&vanBreugel 2024 (PMC11461137) WT free flight 1.8-2.1 Hz across 4 conditions; odor-activated search 2.5-3.4; sink-and-circle 3-4 Hz @~60deg. State-mixed band; old [0.2,2.0] lower bound unsupported

kinematics.speed_cm_s.p50.note: INFERENCE (still): anchors only - wind 30-60 cm/s + surge 0.8 m/s + cast 0.25 m/s (Pang 2018); >200 cm/s 'uncharacteristically high' filter in Stupski 2024 (citing Leitch 2021/Straw 2010/Medici&Fry 2012); measured distribution not yet text-verified

segments.mean_straightness.note: INFERENCE (numeric band = modeling convention); structural premise VERIFIED qualitative: 'straight flight segments separated by rapid turns' Tammero&Dickinson 2002 (PMID 11854370)
